title: Kara:
title_short: Kara · Fall and Winter, Made Easier
headline: One mom, one worry: when it gets cold her baby gets fevers, a stuffy nose and bad sleep. Here is how her day goes now.
story: Selfie-style lifestyle UGC. Kara talks to her phone with baby Madeleine on her lap or her hip. One theme: the season change worries her (fever, stuffy nose, sleep), and each worry has one small helper inside her real day: check on the baby, clear the nose, the patch, white noise at bedtime.

Momcozy's note on this script: the product parts must not feel like a list or an unboxing. So every product beat is her using it on the baby, not her holding it up. Cut away from her face to the real use as soon as the product is named. No talking-head-only stretches longer than 4 s.

Loops: L1 “What goes wrong for babies in the cold?” opens at 0:00 and closes at 0:11. L2 “How does she handle it now?” opens on “But now” at 0:15 and closes on the button at 0:55. Stakes: a sick, sleepless baby when the weather turns.
do: Open on her face and the baby, already talking, hook text already on screen at 0:00.
The baby is on camera in every row.
Cut to real use on the baby on every product line: monitor screen, aspirator, patch, white noise.
Use her real words only, the takes named in the table.
dont: No logo, no name, no fade at 0:00.
No product lineup shots. IMG_9389 00:07 to 00:28 is all products on the nightstand: do not use it.
Do not use “as a first-time mom”. Cut her line after “for me” (Kara is not a first-time mom).
No director voice: “and action”, “perfect”, “one more time”.
No baby fussing at the aspirator. No freeze frames.
